params.description: Unique ID of the approver making a request

params.name: approverUserName
params.description: Unique user-name of the approver making a request

params.name: createDate
params.description: Filter by reports created this date (yyyy-MM-dd)

params.name: createSource
params.description: How the report was created

params.name: exportDate
params.description: Filter by reports exported this date (yyyy-MM-dd)

params.name: getPDFReport
params.description: Flag to indicate if PDF report should be included

params.name: getPDFReportWithNotes
params.description: Flag to indicate if PDF report with notes should be included

params.name: imageFirst
params.description: Flag to indicate if image should be retrieved first

params.name: includeCollections
params.description: List of collections to include in the report

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return. If no value is passed, it will be taken from the configurable property file, where this value is equal to 10 by default

params.name: offset
params.description: The (zero-based) offset of the first item returned in the collection. If no value is passed, it will be taken from the configurable property file, where this value is equal to 10 by default. This value is limited to 100 to ensure reasonable use of system resources.
